name: Habibur Analytics
author: Habibur Rahman

sections.description:
Habibur Analytics is a fast, lightweight, and privacy-friendly analytics plugin for WordPress. It tracks pageviews without using cookies, without collecting personal data, and without slowing down your website.

Unlike heavy analytics platforms, Habibur Analytics is built specifically for performance, simplicity, and privacy compliance.

Perfect for:
– Bloggers
– Business websites
– Portfolio sites
– Agency websites
– Privacy-conscious website owners

Why Choose Habibur Analytics?

✔ No cookies
✔ No personal data collection
✔ GDPR compliant
✔ CCPA compliant
✔ Lightweight & fast
✔ No external tracking scripts
✔ Simple and clean

Privacy First

Habibur Analytics does NOT:
– Use cookies
– Store personal user data
– Share data with third parties
– Track users across websites

All tracking is anonymous and focused only on pageview statistics.

Lightweight & Performance Optimized

The plugin is designed to:
– Load minimal resources
– Avoid external API calls
– Keep your site fast
– Work seamlessly with caching plugins

If you care about performance and privacy, Habibur Analytics is built for you.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/habibur-analytics directory, or install via the WordPress plugin repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. That’s it! Pageview tracking starts automatically.

No complicated setup required.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin use cookies?

No. Habibur Analytics does not use cookies.

Is this plugin GDPR compliant?

Yes. Since it does not collect personal data or use cookies, it is fully GDPR compliant.

Is this plugin CCPA compliant?

Yes. The plugin does not collect personal data and respects user privacy.

Does it slow down my website?

No. The plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance.

Does it track logged-in users?

You can configure tracking behavior (if available in future versions). By default, it focuses on general pageviews.
